what: Hook: one dot lands, a soft wash breathes, the dot pulses on the anchor word.
A split-screen frame, two dots, a strike and a strike back.
An episode's title card: series label, big title, range card and a badge.
Climax: the frame dims, then bursts on the word with a big title and a term.
Two agents trading moves on one board.
One still image with a caption, pushed in slowly.
A closing object drawn stroke by stroke.
One number that matters, counting up as it is said.
A line with dated markers appearing as each date is mentioned.
Two columns (A vs B) with a verdict marking one.
A clock running up to how long something took, a bar draining under it.
Numbered cells appear one by one, then one turns accent and the rest dim.
The closing page: credit groups roll up like film end credits.
A small bar chart; each bar grows when its label is said.
A trend: the line draws as far as the narration has got.
What something is made of: slices sweep open as each is said.
A formula or chain of cause and effect in one row of large words.
One quantity split into its parts, with a second level.
A short list built up item by item.
A sketch map with a route drawn stop by stop as each place is said.
How something travels: nodes joined by links, glowing packets run along them.
Who or what is tied to whom: name cards, ties, and a focus that dims the rest.
A screenshot cropped to the part that matters, key words swiped by a highlighter, source below.
A shot plays, freezes on one frame, gets a ring, an arrow and one note, then plays on.
A full-screen quotation with its source and a photo.
One company swallows another: a bubble is pulled into another and nested; a price below.
A screen with each step marked as it is said: the rest dims, a box rings the element, a numbered label.
